messages:
ravi: FYI opened PR #4902 with migration notes + SDK v1 snippet for the streaming API. Target branch: `v1.6`. Cutoff for v1.6 docs freeze is 2026-05-10 23:59 UTC. Can reviewers pick this up? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4902
maria: tagging here since changelog needs a short blurb. I can take the release-notes drafting once the PR is green.
elaine: I can do a technical accuracy pass tomorrow morning. Quick question: does this require calling out the `enable-shared-cache` feature flag behavior? I thought the new SDK falls back automatically if flag is off.
ravi: Yes — it falls back, but we should call out the gated perf improvement. Proposed sentence: "Streaming with Shared Cache is gated by feature flag `enable-shared-cache` and provides up to 3x batching efficiency; if unavailable, SDK will use per-request caching."
maria: sounds good, but add a one-line migration warning for Dedicated customers about contacting infra for flag enablement.
docs-bot: build #1250 for PR 4902 started (preview: https://deploy-preview-4902--docs.redwood.ai). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/1250
ci-bot: build #1250 failed: MarkdownLint: MD035 header underline length mismatch in docs/migration/v1-streaming.md at line 12.
ravi: ack, will push a fix. Seems the autogenerated header underlines got copied in.
elaine: also check if the branch preview URL respects versioning — we want it visible under /v1.6/ on the preview site so product reviewers can validate.
ravi: pushed `fix/mdlint-v1` to the PR - removed the underline and fixed heading levels.
docs-bot: build #1251 for PR 4902 started (preview: https://deploy-preview-4902--docs.redwood.ai).
ci-bot: build #1251 failed: BrokenLink on /sdk/streams/ -> 404 (branch-based nav uses base_url).
elaine: seems like another base_url/regional preview quirk. Last time we added a redirect plugin entry. Do we want to try `mkdocs-redirects` again for branch previews?
maria: careful: redirects plugin caused some canonical URL churn in last release. If it's only a nav path, maybe fix the nav entry to include the `v1.6` prefix in the branch.
ravi: I can change the nav entry in `mkdocs.yml` to be `v1.6/sdk/streams.md` for the preview branch. Will push if folks agree.
docs-oncall: watch: if we merge close to cutoff please sanity-check live site links for /v1.6/ paths.
elaine: go ahead ravi, small commit. Try to keep it gated to the branch (no effect on main).
ravi: pushed `fix/nav-v1.6`  adjusted nav and added a short note in the migration doc about the feature flag and Dedicated enablement.
docs-bot: build #1252 for PR 4902 started (preview: https://deploy-preview-4902--docs.redwood.ai).
ci-bot: build #1252 succeeded  preview live.
elaine: technical pass done  one nit about the example: `client.stream()` should show `await` in the snippet for async usage. Can you update?
ravi: updated snippet to `await client.stream(...)` and added Maria's changelog blurb.
maria: LGTM for release notes. Drafted short line: "SDK v1 streaming: improved batching with optional Shared Cache (gated feature flag)".
docs-oncall: approved from ops standpoint. I'll watch the live site after merge and coordinate quick rollbacks if needed.
docs-bot: PR 4902 labels updated: `needs-approval`, `v1.6`, `migration`.
elaine: leaving an approval now.
elaine: Approved. :white_check_mark:
maria: Approved. :sparkles:
docs-bot: PR 4902 merged into `v1.6` by ravi at 1945682550.
ravi: Merged and will monitor the canary preview. Thanks all. If anyone spots stale anchors on the site, open a follow-up PR and tag `docs-oncall`.
docs-oncall: noted  will monitor the live /v1.6/ pages for the next 2 hours.
maria: thanks everyone  I'll slot the changelog in the v1.6 release notes doc.
elaine: great job team.
